text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
The King falls to the blade of the 
Princess! This is the power of 
revolution—! ...However, it will take far 
more than this to bring me down!

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
I tell the girl who is my candidate for a 
lifelong rival: Be prepared to stand 
shoulder-to-shoulder with me as a worthy 
foe! ...And this is something that applies 
to myself as well.

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
Her past glorious triumphs changed how 
others looked at her. Tight marks now 
obstruct her natural running. Ah! What a 
thorny path, so truly fitting for a king 
to forge through!

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
Now is the time to carve out a path and 
forge my dynasty. The stage to declare my 
realm—is the Japan Cup!
